text: Our floor washroom has had zero water since morning exams started
Bubbler fountain in the arts block sprays water sideways
Maybe we can collect AC condensate water for the plants
Sparks flew out of the extension board in the staff room
Half the classroom lights on the second floor do not work
How about a poster campaign reminding everyone to switch off lights
Stinking heap of garbage near the back gate has been there for ten days
Chips packets and cold drink cans lying around the football field
Can we get a bin for e-waste like old chargers
Sewer water is overflowing into the ground floor passage
Staff room tables are never wiped and look greasy
Suggest cleaning the fan blades once a semester
Roof sheet above the bicycle stand is loose and flapping, risk of falling
Main entrance door of the lab does not close properly
Maybe label the rooms with bigger signs
A huge old banyan tree is being chopped near the main road
The hedge outside the library looks scruffy and uncut
Would be lovely to add a butterfly garden somewhere
